title: test(console): pin the object-storage-sync-refused advisory on every object save and publish door
body:
Fixes #30723

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:只加测试。把服务端 `object-storage-sync-refused` 告警(原样复制生产者的形状,`path` 为空串)喂进控制台对象保存/发布的四个入口,钉住管理员一定能看到带服务端 message 与 hint 的警告。
- **为什么改**:卡片预期第二条——控制台本来就通用地渲染 `advisories`,这里核实它在对象保存/发布入口确实生效;此前没有任何测试用这条规则的真实形状(空 `path`)走过这些入口。
- **风险与回滚**:零运行时风险,没有改任何源码、文案、i18n 键或 package.json;回滚即删掉两个测试块。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/useMetadataClient.advisorySink.test.tsx`(新 describe:save / publish / publishDraft / publishPackageDrafts 四个入口);`ui/packages/app-shell/src/services/MetadataService.saveAdvisories.test.ts`(新 describe:适配器 `meta.saveItem`,即 Setup 的对象保存)。
- **两分钟验证**:在 `ui/` 下运行 `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/useMetadataClient.advisorySink.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/services/MetadataService.saveAdvisories.test.ts`,预期 2 个文件、13 个测试全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Tests only. One finding in the exact shape `objectStorageSyncRefusedNotice` returns (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-registry-hydration.ts`, copied verbatim with a comment naming the file and function; no new dependency), driven through every console object write door with a real client over a fake `fetch`:

- `useMetadataClient.advisorySink.test.tsx`, new top-level `describe` (the real hook, factory, `MetadataClient`, `readSaveAdvisories` and `emitSaveAdvisories`; only `sonner` and `fetch` stubbed):
  - (a) `save('object', …)` in publish mode: resolves, warning titled "Saved";
  - (b) `publish` and `publishDraft`: resolve, warning titled "Published";
  - (c) `publishPackageDrafts`, the finding on one `published[]` element: resolves, warning titled "Published".
- `MetadataService.saveAdvisories.test.ts`, new top-level `describe`: (d) `MetadataService.saveObject` through the adapter's `meta.saveItem` interceptor: resolves, event `door: 'save'`, `mode: 'publish'`, warning titled "Saved".

Each pin asserts the warning tier (never `error`), and that the description carries `[object-storage-sync-refused] object "NAME" — MESSAGE` and the `hint`, verbatim.

The check itself (the card's Expected bullet 2): the positions the claim measured hold on `40a9265ff`. The producer returns all six string keys with `path: ''`; `readSaveAdvisories` keeps a finding with an empty-string `path` (it checks `typeof`, not truthiness); `useMetadataClient` wires `onSaveAdvisory` into every console `MetadataClient`; `AdapterProvider` subscribes to the adapter's `meta.saveItem` interceptor; both render through `emitSaveAdvisories`. No console object-write door was found that does not reach a sink: the other `MetadataClient` constructions are the adapter's private one (a view draft save and view resets, not object writes, and drafts are never advised), `MetadataProvider`'s preview client (reads only), and the two `plugin-designer` pages (no console consumer). The only response schemas declaring `advisories` are the save, single-item publish and batch publish-drafts responses, all covered above.

## Tests

Run on `da4bf8058` (the final head), from `ui/`:

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/useMetadataClient.advisorySink.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/services/MetadataService.saveAdvisories.test.ts`: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 13 passed (13)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, which compiles the tests): exit 0.
- `eslint` on the two files: exit 0.

### Ablations (each restored; `git diff HEAD` empty after each, blob equal to HEAD)

Done through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which proved each mutation landed on disk. The `@object-ui/data-objectstack` import resolves to `src` through the `ui/vitest.config.mts` alias, so no rebuild was needed.

| Ablation | Result |
|:--|:--|
| A1: `readSaveAdvisories` also requires a non-empty `path` (length greater than zero) | exactly the 5 new pins red, all 8 existing pins green (5 failed / 8 passed). The existing gate-finding fixtures carry a non-empty `path`, so only this shape can catch it |
| A2: the console sink call `emitSaveAdvisories(…)` in `useMetadataClient` cut | the 4 new `MetadataClient` pins red, plus the 2 existing SAVE/PUBLISH connection pins (6 failed / 7 passed) |
| A3: the adapter interceptor's emit cut (its condition made never true) | the new `saveItem` pin red, plus the 3 existing `MetadataService` advisory pins (4 failed / 9 passed) |

The first attempt at A1 was a no-op: its anchor was a substring of its replacement, so the tool refused to run (anchor count 1 to 1) and restored the file. It was re-run with an anchor that does not overlap; the table above shows that second run.

## Acceptance notes

- Out of scope, observed (from the claim; not changed here): the frame reads "the authoring check raised N advisory finding(s)", but this finding comes from the storage sync, not the authoring gate. That is wording, not behaviour.
- The producer copy is a fixture. If the server's wording changes, the pins still pass (they compare the fixture's own strings), so they guard the console channel and not the server text. That matches the renderer contract: server prose is rendered verbatim and never pinned by the console.
- The batch door reaches the console once #30693 lands server-side. The client half is pinned here already.

## Verification

These include `check:test-source-alias`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:type-check-coverage`, `check:type-check-debt`, `check:undeclared-dep-imports`, `check:published-files`, `check-sdui-manifest` (and `--self-test`), `check-comment-mask-corpus` and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`, each exit 0.

The whole `@object-ui/app-shell` suite (`Test UI`) and the repo-wide lint are left to CI. Locally I ran the two changed files plus the package type-check, which compiles the tests. `skip-changeset`: the diff touches only `*.test.ts(x)`, which no package's `files[]` ships.
